# Context OS by ContextLM

> 产品全称 Context OS by ContextLM：可本地部署的个人 AI 知识库——文档入库与问答、答案溯源到原文、通过 MCP / API 外接 Agent、会员解锁可分享名额。品牌：ContextLM。

## Public docs

- [Agent API 接入（agent-readable）](https://app.contextlm.top/help/api-access/agents)：面向 Agent 的 MCP / HTTP 调用、工作区密钥与权限边界。
- [MCP 接入总入口](https://app.contextlm.top/integrations/mcp)：统一 MCP 端点、工作区工具目录、调用示例与权限边界。
- [接入 Cursor](https://app.contextlm.top/integrations/cursor)：把工作区知识库接进 Cursor（本地 stdio / 云端 MCP HTTP）的可复现步骤。
- [接入 Claude Desktop](https://app.contextlm.top/integrations/claude-desktop)：让 Claude Desktop 经 MCP 查询工作区（stdio 配置 / 远程连接器）。
- [人类 API 接入说明](https://app.contextlm.top/help/api-access)：每个工作区单独管理密钥；自动化代理请用 Agent 文档与 Agent Pack。
- [产品 FAQ](https://app.contextlm.top/help/faq)：MCP / Agent 接入、工作区密钥边界、可分享名额、BYOK、会员与余额定价。
- [选型对比](https://app.contextlm.top/help/compare)：Context OS 与笔记内置 AI、第二大脑、通用 RAG 套件的中立对比。
- [定价与充值](https://app.contextlm.top/pricing)：会员档位（Free / Plus / Pro）与余额充值、BYOK。
- [桌面客户端（免费）](https://app.contextlm.top/desktop)：Windows 客户端，数据留在本机，支持 MCP / CLI。
- [品牌官网](https://www.contextlm.top)：ContextLM 品牌与创作者空间。

## English pages

- [Home](https://app.contextlm.top/en): locally deployable personal AI knowledge base — docs in, answers out, external agents via MCP / API.
- [Pricing](https://app.contextlm.top/en/pricing): membership tiers (Free / Plus / Pro) and wallet top-up, BYOK.
- [Desktop client](https://app.contextlm.top/en/desktop): free Windows client, data stays local, MCP / CLI for local agents.
- [Product FAQ](https://app.contextlm.top/en/help/faq): MCP / agent access, workspace key boundaries, share slots, BYOK, membership and wallet pricing.
- [Comparison](https://app.contextlm.top/en/help/compare): neutral comparison of Context OS vs notes AI, second-brain apps, and general RAG stacks.
- [API access](https://app.contextlm.top/en/help/api-access): per-workspace keys; automated agents should use the agent docs and Agent Pack.
- [Agent API docs](https://app.contextlm.top/en/help/api-access/agents): agent-readable MCP / HTTP calls, workspace keys, and permission boundaries.
- [Legal center](https://app.contextlm.top/en/legal): terms of service, privacy policy, and open-source notices.
- [Terms of Service](https://app.contextlm.top/en/legal/terms): binding terms for using Context OS (Chinese version prevails).
- [Privacy Policy](https://app.contextlm.top/en/legal/privacy): what we collect, third-party processors, your rights; no model training on your docs.
- [Open-source notices](https://app.contextlm.top/en/legal/licenses): major components, weak-copyleft notes, and the full third-party list.
